migration_slices.title: Migration slice: Source inventory and provenance slice
migration_slices.data_integrity_invariant: A source record is not a resolved person, account, membership, or representative authority.
migration_slices.reconciliation_dependency: Depends on reconciliation evidence a later gate will require.
migration_slices.rollback_dependency: Depends on the migration rollback requirements planned in V10-15.

migration_slices.title: Migration slice: Mapping and identity-candidate slice
migration_slices.data_integrity_invariant: Mapping completed is not identity resolved.
migration_slices.reconciliation_dependency: Depends on reconciliation evidence a later gate will require.
migration_slices.rollback_dependency: Depends on the migration rollback requirements planned in V10-15.

migration_slices.title: Migration slice: Coexistence, reconciliation, and cutover slice
migration_slices.data_integrity_invariant: A migration executed is not a business acceptance and is not a source retirement.
migration_slices.reconciliation_dependency: Depends on reconciliation evidence a later gate will require.
migration_slices.rollback_dependency: Depends on the migration rollback requirements planned in V10-15.

migration_readiness_requirements.title: Source-provenance and quarantine migration readiness requirement
migration_readiness_requirements.rehearsal_requirement: Requires rehearsed migration in a recovery-exercise environment before any cutover consideration.
migration_readiness_requirements.reconciliation_requirement: Requires reconciliation evidence between source and House records.
migration_readiness_requirements.rollback_dependency: Requires a rehearsed rollback path; rollback remains a planning concept only.
